arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back, 7 turns. Goal: fastest finish. After the hard start, settle to about critical power (pod shaft ~181-186 W, boat ~119 W) and hold it evenly; keep pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) above ~40 pct until 1500 m to go, then spend it: push from ~1500 m, finish sprint at ~400 m. Judge effort mainly from the pod; compare same-direction legs to separate current from fatigue. Watch for: rudder weed (GPS speed and push_local drop while pod power holds -> clear_rudder), pod drift (pod power moves but GPS speed and boat-model power do not), wind/current shifts, radio course changes (set_race_distance and tell).

arguments.name: drag_anomaly
arguments.description: Local push not explained by the fitted current along the heading: strongly negative = extra drag (weed on rudder) or new headwind.

arguments.message: Boat slower than pod power explains: check for weed on rudder or wind shift.
Pod reserve below 35 pct with more than 1500 m left.

arguments.reason: Check where the paddler settles after the start.
Start of final push phase: decide how much reserve to spend.

text: no cue: hard start is normal, set plan, weed and low-reserve watches, waking at 3 min to see where effort settles.

arguments.text: 3.2 min: settled on pod 185 W (CP 181, sustainable 186) at 65 spm, pod reserve 72 pct. Boat-model reserve reads lower (51 pct) because local push 0.25 > fitted push 0.17 on leg 1 (north): trust the pod for effort. Ratio boat/shaft power ~0.70 on leg 1.

text: no cue: paddler settled on critical power by the pod (185 W vs 181), exactly the sustainable effort.

arguments.message: Speed at same stroke rate fading more than 3 pct: real fatigue or extra drag.

arguments.text: 6.2 min (leg 2, south, against ~0.17 m/s current): pod 184 W, pod reserve 67 pct, no fade (-0.7). Boat-model reserve 19 pct (boat/shaft ratio ~0.70 vs 0.657 in the test, on both legs, so boat CP 119 looks low, not current). Paddler said 7/10 really hurting. Decision: hold, do not trust boat reserve alone; act if fade watch fires or paddler gets worse.

text: no cue: pod effort right at critical power with no fade; boat-model reserve looks miscalibrated; added fade watch.

arguments.text: Weed on the rudder. Quick back-stroke to clear it, then go.

9.2 min (~1750 m): step drop at race_s ~410-430: boat power 130->120 W while pod 185->187 W, push_local -0.13->-0.21, fade -3.2 pct; paddler: boat feels heavy, something dragging (6/10). Cued clear_rudder at 9.2 min. Check after: boat/shaft power ratio should return to ~0.70 (it was 0.645 with the weed).

arguments.reason: Check whether clearing the rudder restored boat speed for the same pod power.

text: Cued clear_rudder: step loss of boat power for the same pod power plus the paddler feeling drag points to weed on the rudder.

arguments.text: Still dragging. One firm back-stroke now to clear the rudder.
10.5 min: first clear_rudder (9.2 min) not done: back_stroke_seen false, boat/shaft ratio still 0.64-0.65, fade -3.7. Repeated clear_rudder at 10.5 min at the turn into leg 3.

arguments.reason: Check whether the second clear_rudder restored boat speed for the same pod power.

text: Repeated clear_rudder: no back-stroke was seen after the first cue and the boat still loses about 7 pct of power to drag.
no cue: back-stroke was done 30 s ago and the 30-s means still include it and the turn; checking recovery at the 11.8 min wake-up.

arguments.name: eff_ratio
arguments.description: Boat-model power per pod shaft power. Clean: ~0.72 north legs, ~0.70 south legs; with rudder weed it fell to 0.645.

arguments.message: Boat power per pod power low away from turns: possible weed on rudder, wind shift or pod drift.

arguments.text: 11.8 min (2256 m, leg 3 north): rudder CLEARED by the 10.6 min back-stroke: boat/shaft ratio back to 0.74, fade 0.1, push_local 0.26 like leg 1. Pod 180 W, pod reserve 57 pct, sustainable pod 186 W. Boat-model reserve (12 pct) is unreliable: boat CP 119 too low vs pod; ignore it. New watch drag2 on eff_ratio replaces weed watch.

text: no cue: rudder is clear and speed restored; effort on critical power by the pod, plan unchanged.
no cue: pod effort steady at critical power, no fade, rudder clean; boat-model reserve at 0 is a miscalibration since speed holds.

arguments.text: Strong and steady. Lift a touch into the current: 2:43 pace.

8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m, out (north, current helps ~+0.17 m/s) and back (south, against). Fastest finish: hold about pod critical power (181-186 W) on north legs, a little more (~188-190 W, ground pace ~2:43) on south legs where extra power buys the most time. Pace targets carry through turns, so re-cue at EVERY turn: north legs hold ~2:28 (148 s/500), south legs push ~2:43 (163). Keep pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) >= ~35 pct into the last leg (leg 8, south, from 7000 m), then spend it all; finish sprint ~400 m. Trust the pod, not the boat-model reserve (boat CP 119 is too low). Watch for weed (eff_ratio drop away from turns -> clear_rudder), pod drift, wind shifts, radio course changes.

arguments.reason: Just after the turn into leg 5 (north): re-cue hold at ~2:28 so the south-leg pace target is not carried into the current-assisted leg.

arguments.text: 17.9 min (3430 m, leg 4 south): paddler 5/10 really hurting (was 7 at 6 min, 6 at 9 min); no fade, pod 179-183 W, pod reserve 50 pct, sustainable pod 186. Legs: out 3.40/3.35 m/s, back 2.97 (weed)/3.02. Cued push to 2:43 on leg 4 south.

text: Cued push to 2:43 on the against-current leg: extra power buys most time where ground speed is lowest, reserve 50 pct allows it.

arguments.reason: Race committee radio: course extended by one leg, finish now at 9000 m.

arguments.text: Turning now. Hold steady, 2:29 pace on this leg.

arguments.reason: Tell the paddler the course is now 9000 m (distance_left_m from here) as soon as the cue gate allows.
Final push phase (of the 9000 m course): decide how much reserve to spend.

arguments.text: Course now 9000 m (radio at 20.7 min): 9 legs of 1000 m, odd legs north (current helps ~+0.17 m/s), even legs south (against). Last leg (8000-9000) is NORTH. Fastest finish: hold about pod critical power (181-186 W) on north legs (ground pace ~2:29), a little more on south legs (~2:43) where extra power buys the most time. Pace targets carry through turns, so re-cue at EVERY turn. Spend the remaining pod reserve mostly on leg 8 (south, 7000-8000 m) and the last 500 m; finish sprint ~400 m. Make sure the paddler knows the finish is at 9000 m. Trust the pod, not the boat-model reserve (boat CP 119 too low). Watch for weed (eff_ratio drop away from turns -> clear_rudder), pod drift, wind shifts, more radio changes.

20.7 min (3950 m): RADIO course extended to 9000 m; set_race_distance 9000. Cued hold 2:29 at the turn into leg 5 north (so the 2:43 south target is not carried over). Still need to TELL paddler the new finish (wake in 62 s). Push to 2:43 on leg 4 had little effect (pod 179-185). Pod reserve 46 pct.

text: Course extended to 9000 m: corrected race distance, cued hold 2:29 at the turn, will tell the paddler the new finish in 62 s.

arguments.text: Course extended one leg. Finish at 9000, 4.8 km to go.

21.8 min (4170 m, leg 5 north): TOLD paddler finish at 9000 m (4820 m left). Before that they were at pod 197 W (above CP), pace 2:24, pod reserve 41 pct and falling - maybe they thought the finish was near. Check next wake-up that effort settles to ~185 W; if still >190 on this north leg, cue hold/ease 2:29.

arguments.reason: Check effort settles near 185 W after telling the paddler about the 9000 m finish.

text: Told the paddler the finish moved to 9000 m (4.8 km left) because they were pushing above critical power as if the end were near.

arguments.reason: Just before the turn into leg 6 (south, against current): cue push to about 2:42.
Just before the turn into leg 7 (north, with current): cue hold at about 2:29 so the south target is not carried over.

arguments.text: 23.2 min (4440 m, leg 5 north): settled after the tell cue: pod 177-180 W, ground pace 2:28, pod reserve 40 pct and steady, no fade. Reserve to spend: ~5.7 kJ over 4.5 km. Plan: push leg 6 south lightly (2:42), hold leg 7 north (2:29), push leg 8 south harder, sprint end of leg 9.

text: no cue: paddler settled at critical power on the north leg after hearing the new finish; turn wake-ups set.

arguments.text: Turning into the current. Push a little: 2:42 pace.

text: Cued push to 2:42 for the against-current leg 6: pod reserve 41 pct with 4 km left leaves room to spend some where it buys most time.

arguments.text: Good push. Settle a touch now, 2:44, save some for leg eight.

arguments.message: Pod reserve below 15 pct with more than 600 m left: risk of emptying.

arguments.reason: Just before the turn into leg 7 (north, with current): cue hold at about 2:29 so the south target is not carried over.
Just before the turn into leg 8 (south, against current): cue push to spend most of the remaining reserve on this leg, keep ~10 pct for the last 300 m.
Just before the turn into the last leg 9 (north): hold near critical power and plan the final sprint.

arguments.text: Course 9000 m (extended by radio at 20.7 min; paddler told). 9 legs of 1000 m: odd legs north (current helps ~+0.17 m/s), even legs south (against); last leg 9 (8000-9000) is NORTH. Pod CP 181 W, critical power by pod is the anchor; ignore the boat-model reserve (boat CP 119 too low). Reserve budget: leg 6 rest ~2:44; leg 7 north hold ~2:29 (CP); leg 8 south push (~2:41-2:42) spending most of what is left; keep ~10 pct pod reserve for a sprint over the last ~300 m of leg 9 (cue gate: no cue in last 100 m, so call finish at ~350-400 m). Re-cue at every turn because pace targets carry through turns. Watches: drag2 (weed/drag), fade, reserve_crit (<15 pct with >600 m left).

27.8 min (5344 m, leg 6 south): the 2:42 push worked this time (pod 192 W, ground 2:43) but reserve fell to 34 pct; at that rate ~17 pct by the turn, too little for leg 8. Cued ease to 2:44 (expect ~185 W). Wake-ups set before turns at 3040, 2040, 1040 m to go.

text: Cued a slight ease to 2:44: the push was spending reserve faster than planned (34 pct with 3.7 km left); saving it for the against-current leg 8.

arguments.text: Ease to 2:46, long and smooth. Recover on the next leg.

29.4 min (5627 m, leg 6 south): paddler said I am cooked, I cannot hold this. Pod 190 W (above CP 181), pod reserve 28 pct, no fade yet. First ease cue (27.9) barely changed power. Cued ease to 2:46 (~CP). Leg 7 north: hold ~2:30 slightly below CP to let them recover, then reassess (ask_paddler) before pushing leg 8.

text: Cued ease to 2:46 (about critical power): paddler says cooked after the push, pod reserve 28 pct, protecting against a blow-up with 3.4 km left.

arguments.text: Turning. Easy rhythm with the current, 2:30 pace, recover.

31.2 min (5962 m): ease to 2:46 worked (pod 178-180, reserve steady 27 pct). fade -2 is from lower power, eff_ratio 0.70 = no drag. Cued hold 2:30 at the turn into leg 7 north (slightly below CP, ~174 W) to let the cooked paddler recover; ask how they feel before the leg 8 push.

text: Cued hold 2:30 for the current-assisted leg 7: slightly below critical power so the paddler recovers before the against-current leg 8.

arguments.text: 34.2 min (6550 m, leg 7 north): pod 167-171 W (below CP), reserve recovering to 35 pct, paddler 7/10 really hurting (no longer says cooked). eff_ratio 0.73 clean. Budget for the last 2450 m (~5 kJ): leg 8 south push ~+10 W (2:42), leg 9 north at CP to 400 m left, then finish sprint.

text: no cue: paddler recovering slightly below critical power on the current-assisted leg as planned; push comes at the turn into leg 8.

arguments.text: Turning. Into the current, push now: 2:42 pace.

36.3 min (6962 m): recovered on leg 7 to pod reserve 40 pct (5.6 kJ). Cued push 2:42 at the turn into leg 8 south (expect ~190-192 W, ~3.5 kJ, leaving ~15 pct). At the 1040 m wake: hold ~2:29 on leg 9 north, then finish cue at ~400 m to go.

arguments.reason: Mid leg 8: check the push is spending reserve at the planned rate (aim ~25 pct here, ~15 pct at the last turn).
Call the finish sprint (cue finish) with ~400 m to go; no cues allowed in the last 100 m.

text: Cued push to 2:42 for the against-current leg 8: 40 pct pod reserve with 2 km left, spend most of it where it buys the most time.

arguments.text: Too early! Ease back to 2:42, sprint comes at 400 m.

39.4 min (7505 m, 1495 left): paddler started own sprint early: pod 189->215 W and rate 65->68.6 in 15 s (rate rise = real effort, not pod drift), boat power starting to follow. Pod reserve 28 pct, would empty in ~420 m. Paddler 6/10 really hurting. Cued ease to 2:42 (sustainable ~190 W). Plan: ~190 W to the last turn, hold ~2:29 on leg 9 north, finish cue at ~400 m.

text: Cued ease to 2:42: the paddler launched a sprint with 1.5 km left at 215 W, which would empty the reserve in about 400 m.

arguments.reason: Next cue allowed: paddler is sprinting at ~236 W as if the finish were at the next turn (the old 8000 m finish). Tell them the finish is 9000 m (one more leg) unless they already eased.

arguments.text: 39.8 min (7592 m, 1408 left): pod 236 W, rate 69, pod reserve 17 pct (empties in 146 m). The sprint started ~500 m before the OLD 8000 m finish (the next turn) - paddler likely still believes 8000 m. eff_ratio 0.58 is the high-rate sprint, not weed (rate rose). Next cue (40.5 min): TELL finish 9000 m / distance left, then hold.

text: no cue (gate closed 41 s): paddler sprinting toward the old 8000 m finish; waking when the next cue is allowed to tell them the real finish.
no cue (gate closed 31 s): reserve alert expected from the early sprint; the pending wake-up will tell the paddler the real finish.

arguments.text: Finish is not at the turn. One more leg, 1250 m.

40.6 min (7740 m, 1260 left): ease cue at 39.4 was ignored (pod 198->236). Pod reserve 0. Paddler 9/10 hurting, not sure I can hold this (real effort, no drag complaint). Speed 3.10 -> 3.03, likely starting to fade. Cued TELL: finish not at the turn, 1250 m left. At the last turn: hold steady near CP (~2:30 north), let reserve come back, finish cue only at ~300-400 m.

text: Told the paddler the finish is one more leg (1250 m): they are sprinting with an empty reserve as if the turn were the finish.
